edges_rejected_or_unproved: Four library holdings of the 1986 edition do not create four 1458 witnesses.
The 1986 volume's bibliographic citation does not identify the physical copy used for the 2008 Fig.1 photograph.
The NuriIDT manual's demonstration result is not a new image witness or a live retrieved source page.
A 404 on two SNU thumbnail URLs does not prove the original item has no accessible image.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Can the live NuriIDT demo return the exact preface page for 交食推步法 or query terms 金石梯 / 金石悌 / 定限 / 定恨?
Does the 2008 Fig.1 image reproduce the SNU 奎貴67 original, the 1986 volume5, or another physical copy?
Can a provider-issued source image or a page in the 1986 volume5 be acquired without login, fee or contact?

next_source_action: Use only the already-public NuriIDT demo route to search exact Chinese-character terms if the interactive search can be executed without account or fee; capture the provider-issued result/page identifiers and original image only if exposed. In parallel, retain the 1986 volume5 as a modern bibliographic reproduction lead, not an original witness. Do not contact libraries, request paid copies, register accounts, infer missing URLs or promote the manual screenshot to a live original image.
